rule: Yesterday's Whoop day strain > 16 adds evening mobility for the loaded area to today's recovery prescription
summary: Whoop strain is a proprietary HR-based load score; independent data are limited to a single-athlete study showing it tracks session-RPE load. Wrist HR is less accurate during resistance and mixed work (burpees, rows), so strain under-reads gym sessions. The threshold only adds optional mobility, so the cost of a wrong value is negligible.

sources.note: Single elite swimmer, 128 sessions: WHOOP Activity Strain associated with session-RPE load and distance
WHOOP 3.0 HR agreement was high for squats but low for rows and burpees - strain from gym work may be under-estimated
